stops.name: Buchberg
stops.detail: The Buchberg is an 801 m above sea level mountain on the territory of the municipality of Mattsee in the district of Salzburg-Umlage in the state of Salzburg. It is constructed from fly rocks and represents the highest elevation in the area of the Wallersee or Mattsee basin.
